reviews.text: Jasmine was absolutely amazing. She made me feel so good about how I had my hair before. And after she was done, I literally felt like a new woman. She is the best and I would see her again every time I need my hair done.
Jasmine was great, was nervous about cutting my hair. She did it beautifully, and I’m so happy I found someone I trust to do my hair.

Came into the salon with a messed up pixie cut from another salon and Jasmine was able to rectify the problem! If you are looking for a precision cut for short hair Jasmine is your girl. Added bonus she’s a sweetheart.
